comparisons.peer_topic: Workforce size, R&D allocation, and geography
comparisons.peer_summary: As of November 3, 2024, Broadcom had approximately 37,000 employees worldwide, with 55% in research and development roles, and geographic distribution of 48% in North America, 36% in Asia, and 16% in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose their total global employee headcount as a primary workforce metric for fiscal year 2024. Broadcom's workforce of approximately 37,000 employees was significantly larger than AMD's approximately 28,000 employees. Additionally, Broadcom provided specific breakdowns by function (55% in R&D) and geography, whereas AMD's disclosure focused solely on the total aggregate headcount without functional or geographic splits in the cited text.
